text: 【7月住户贷款减少超4600亿元】近日，中国人民银行公示《2026年7月金融统计数据报告》，对比此前数据显示，7月住户贷款减少4603亿元。其中，居民短贷减少3400亿元，居民中长贷减少1202亿元。记者采访了解到，居民贷款减少这主要受房地产市场持续调整、居民消费意愿不足等因素影响。未来随着逆周期调节力度加大，经济增长动能有望增强，居民贷款或回升。
text_en: [Household loans fell over 460 billion yuan in July] The PBOC recently published the July 2026 financial statistics report, showing household loans dropped by 460.3 billion yuan in July. Among them, short-term household loans fell by 340 billion yuan and medium/long-term household loans by 120.2 billion yuan. Reporting suggests the decline was mainly due to ongoing property market adjustments and weak consumer willingness to borrow. As counter-cyclical policy intensifies, economic momentum could strengthen and household loans may recover.
